series_summary.NL: No eligible historical line from the two accepted extension observations. NL 2011 is a legacy-vintage jobs estimate; NL 2020 is an explicitly approximate interim employee estimate.
series_summary.RO: One eligible collaborator-inclusive source-native segment: 2021-2023 only. The accepted 2020 '6,000+' is a separate employee-worded benchmark; 2024 is employee-only and separate.
series_summary.RS: One eligible contextual association-estimate segment: 2021-2025, including existing 2024/2025 national estimates. It must retain 'approximately/estimated' qualifiers and cannot be read as a strict domestic or respondent-employee line.
